contrasts.line: Enjoy means having fun with it. Admire means looking up to skill or goodness.
Enjoy is happy fun. Adore is a huge, over-the-moon liking.
Enjoy is about fun now. Cherish is keeping something precious close.
Missing is about something gone. Enjoying is having fun with it now.
Admire means looking up to skill. Enjoy means having fun with it.
Admire is about being impressed. Adore is a huge warm liking.
Admire looks up to talent. Cherish holds something precious close.
Missing wants them back. Admiring looks up to how good they are.
Adore is huge warm liking. Enjoy is simply having fun.
Adore is over-the-moon liking. Admire is looking up to skill.
Adore is very strong liking. Cherish is keeping something precious close.
Missing is sadness for what is away. Adoring is delight in what is here.
Cherish means keeping something precious close. Enjoy means having fun with it.
Cherish protects a treasure or memory. Admire looks up to skill.
Cherish is holding precious things close. Adore is over-the-moon liking.
Missing is the gap left behind. Cherishing is treasuring what is still yours.
Enjoying is fun while it happens. Missing is the ache when it is gone.
Admiring is looking up to someone. Missing is wishing they were here.
Adoring is huge love up close. Missing is love noticing an empty space.
Cherishing is holding something dear while you have it. Missing is feeling its absence.
